The case path was ORD-001 → ORD-005 → ORD-017 → ORD-023 → ORD-011. ORD-011's record says "shipped," which is the status I report. ORD-023's note says the courier swapped labels between ORD-011 and ORD-027 and that the one that never shipped is the case's order, so the "shipped" status on ORD-011's record may not match the physical shipment. I did not check ORD-027.

Two readings I took:
- "Placed immediately after ORD-016" means ORD-017, using the sequential id order. The records have no timestamps to confirm this.
- For the 4-hop count, I counted each followed note as one hop, starting from ORD-001.
